plainText:
----
 
Puka (Japanese: マイケル Michael) is a ing that appeared in The Pi-Kahuna.

==History==
 
 
Puka is at least 20 years old, having been first found by surfing enthusiast shortly after he failed to conquer a large wave, "Humungadunga" (Japanese: ビッグ・チューズデー Big Tuesday). Victor was trying to emulate a feat achieved by his surfing hero Jan two decades ago. It met up with Ash's Pikachu when he visited with . spotted the two of them together and used their Gyarados submarine to snatch them.

Puka was rescued by Victor after Team Rocket's submarine was attacked by a group of angry . At that moment, Humungadunga made its scheduled appearance, twenty years after Victor first fell to it. and his friends watched from the beach as Victor, with Puka on his surfboard, successfully rode the big wave and planted a flag atop the rock, right next to where Jan first placed his flag forty years earlier. Puka and Victor returned to shore to be greeted by Ash, , and , as well as by young children looking up to Victor in awe. In a similar fashion to what his hero did after riding the big wave, Victor encouraged two young surfers and gifted them Jan's surfboard.

==Personality and characteristics==
Puka has gotten along with Victor very well ever since the time they first met. Puka looks noticeably and larger than Ash's Pikachu, with wrinkles beneath his eyes. His ears have frayed bits of fur at the tips while most Pikachu ears are straight and pointy. His eyes are blue, while Ash's Pikachu's eyes, as well as most Pikachu eyes, are dark brown and have slight but noticeable age lines, indicative of Puka being an older Pikachu. Puka can sense big waves coming to the beach where he lives, causing his eyes to glow. Incidentally, he does not use any attacks throughout the entire episode, even when captured by ; it is Ash's Pikachu that attacks. Whether Puka can in fact use any Electric attacks is up for debate, since his cheeks do not spark during the episode either.
 

==Trivia==
Puka's English name comes from s, which are pieces of a shell belonging to a snail. They are used to make jewelry, and are very popular in Hawaii. "Puka" is also somewhat similar to "Pika", as in "Pikachu".
Puka's Japanese name, along with Victor's Japanese name (Vincent) and Jan's name, are a reference to Hollywood actor , the lead actor of the movie , from which their episode takes inspiration.
Puka might be based on the minigame of the Surfing Pikachu, located in in , near Seafoam Islands.
Puka's blue eyes, surfing motif, and psychic powers make him similar to the , predating the former's debut by 18 years.
